title: Spring menus for the cafe
transcript:
Maya Chen (owner): Thanks for coming by the cafe, Sam.
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Happy to. The spring menu proof is ready.
Maya Chen (owner): I'll pay Harbor Print $480 on Friday for the spring menus.
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Want the rush printing for another $90?
Maya Chen (owner): No, skip the rush. Friday is fine.

traps.description: Sam offers a $90 rush fee and Maya says no.
